items.title: Warsh Said to Stick With Fed Messaging Despite Backlash
items.content: <article>Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh is said to be prepared to stick with his revised communications style despite a selloff in US Treasuries following last week’s Fed meeting, according to a report in the Financial Times. Michael McKee has more on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)</article>

items.title: ‘India’s Top Gun’ Is Netflix’s Most Ambitious Local Production
items.author: Sohee Kim
items.content: <article>Netflix Inc. is turning one of India’s most politically defining chapters into its biggest production in the country yet, betting that a spectacle on the scale of Top Gun can strengthen its position in the world’s most populous market as a premium video platform.</article>

items.title: New ETFs to Watch: Nasdaq 100 Challenger and Multi-Token Launch
items.author: Joel Weber and Eric Balchunas
items.content: In this episode, a Nasdaq 100 challenger, SK Hynix and a multi-token launch.

items.title: SpaceX's Next Big Test Is the $101 Billion (SPCX) Unlock: Live Q&A
items.author: Carmen Arroyo, Bailey Lipschultz, Kelcee Griffis and Edward Ludlow
items.content: Bloomberg journalists answer your questions about SpaceX’s big week in a Live Q&A today at 2 p.m. EDT.

items.title: US Initial Jobless Claims Below 200,000 for Third Straight Week
items.content: <article>Applications for US unemployment benefits edged up to 199,000 in the week ended Aug. 1, according to Labor Department data released Thursday. Claims remained below 200,000 for a third straight week and the four-week moving average fell to the lowest since September 2022. Michael McKee reports on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)</article>

items.title: No Break on Move Higher in Long End of Yield Curve, Al-Hussainy Says
items.content: <article>Edward Al-Hussainy, Total Return bond portfolio manager at Columbia Threadneedle, examines the numerous factors he sees impacting the long end of the yield curve. (Source: Bloomberg)</article>

items.title: Deutsche Bank, KBC Freeze Some Radiant World Funds in Singapore
items.author: Alfred Cang, Katharine Gemmell, Jack Farchy, Priscila Azevedo Rocha, Mark Burton and Arno Schütze
items.content: <article>Radiant World is under growing pressure after two of its key banks froze its funds and major miners moved to cut ties with the iron ore trading house.</article>

items.title: DeepSeek Plans AI Price Hike; Google Reshuffles AI Leadership | Bloomberg Brief 08/06/26
items.content: <article>US equity futures waver as a tech-led rally loses momentum ahead of Friday's payrolls report. DeepSeek plans to implement a significant price increase across its AI services, while Google shakes up its AI leadership. Kelsey Berro of JPMorgan Asset Management discusses the upcoming jobs report and the implications for the Federal Reserve. (Source: Bloomberg)</article>

items.title: Standard Bank’s Kenya Unit to Double Retail Footprint by 2029
items.author: Adelaide Changole
items.content: <article>Standard Bank Group Ltd.’s Kenyan unit plans to double its retail footprint across the East African nation in three years as the continent’s biggest lender seeks to capture more clients and revenue.</article>

items.title: Wall Street Bulls Flock to S&P 500 Calls as Rally Broadens
items.author: Bernard Goyder
items.content: <article>Traders can’t get enough of options betting on more gains in the S&P 500 Index, a gauge that has for months been in the shadow of its more volatile rival, the Nasdaq 100.</article>

items.title: Low Hydropower Stocks in Europe Threaten High Prices for Months
items.author: William Mathis and Eva Brendel
items.content: <article>Repeated heat waves and droughts this summer have put Europe’s power system on high alert, with shrinking hydro reserves in key markets threatening to drive electricity prices higher later in the year.</article>

items.title: Scotiabank's Warrier on Hedge Funds' Tough July
items.content: <article>Mithra Warrier, managing director and global head of financing sales at Scotiabank, joined the program to provide insights as the market approached the close. The discussion highlighted a difficult July for hedge funds, referencing performance data from major firms such as Verition, Balysansy, Schonfeld Partners, Millennium, Point72, and Coatue. The segment focused on the factors contributing to the tough month for these funds and the broader implications for investors and market participants. (Source: Bloomberg)</article>

items.title: Tech Stocks Propel Markets to Record Highs
items.content: <article>Noel Dixon of State Street highlights the continued upside potential in tech stocks, suggesting there is still room for increased exposure and near-term momentum that could lead to further gains. The conversation also previews upcoming insights from Dan Ives of Yorkville Ives & Co, who will address investor concerns related to SpaceX's aggressive spending plans, and Ashok Bhatia of Neuberger, who will discuss why markets may be underestimating the pace of disinflation. Overall, the segment underscores investor confidence despite some jitters around AI developments and corporate spending strategies. (Source: Bloomberg)</article>

items.title: Alphabet Is Seeking Up to $25 Billion From Latest Bond Sale
items.author: Brian Smith, Caleb Mutua and Michael Gambale
items.content: <article>Alphabet Inc. is looking to raise as much as $25 billion from its latest US investment-grade bond offering, a deal that will test investor appetite for AI-related debt following a July selloff.</article>

items.title: Paramount’s Stalled $110 Billion Warner Deal Wins UK Nod
items.author: Upmanyu Trivedi
items.content: <article>Paramount Skydance Corp.’s stalled $110 billion takeover of Warner Bros. Discovery Inc. got some regulatory respite after Britain’s antitrust watchdog and culture minister both decided against escalating their scrutiny of a proposed deal that faces mounting opposition in the US.</article>

items.title: Celsius Shares Slump as Namesake Brand Sales Tumble
items.author: Ann Gehan
items.content: <article>Celsius Holdings Inc. shares tumbled after the energy drink maker’s second-quarter revenue missed expectations as competition hurt sales of its namesake brand.</article>

items.title: China Books 13 More US Soy Cargoes, Nearing Quarter of Target
items.author: Michael Hirtzer and Hallie Gu
items.content: <article>China booked another flurry of US soybean cargoes, as the country makes headway toward fulfilling the purchase pledge made as part of a trade truce struck last year.</article>

items.title: Rheinmetall Pivots to New Frigate to Make Up for Contract Loss
items.author: Laura Alviž
items.content: <article>Rheinmetall AG is turning to its own frigate and several smaller boats to fill up its underused shipyards after losing a German naval contract worth several billion euros.</article>

items.title: Tech Stocks Fall as Higher Oil Prices Boost Yields: Markets Wrap
items.author: Rita Nazareth
items.content: <article>A selloff in technology companies kept a lid on stocks ahead of the jobs report, with higher oil prices raising concerns about inflation and lifting bond yields.</article>

items.title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Aug. 6
items.author: Charles Gorrivan and Paul Burkhardt
items.content: <article>Oil rose in a choppy session as traders waited for a final Iran-Oman deal to partially reopen the Strait of Hormuz, with the US position still unclear.</article>
